notes.title: SAE Alpha 0.1.2: Release Notes
notes.content:
[url=https://www.sae-game.com/post/sae-alpha-0-1-2-release-notes]Read Relese Noten on our Website[/url]

[h3]After receiving a lot of useful information and bug reports in the first week after the release of the Early Access version, the following things have been changed:[/h3]

[list]
[*]XP for breaking crystals reduced to 100 to 220
[*]Increased brightness in the jungle
[*]World border added so that you can no longer fall off the map
[*]Statistic "Coal Ores Mined" now works
[*]Increased Durability on Items:
Iron Axe: 60 → 100
Iron Dagger: 50 → 100
Iron Pickaxe: 60 → 100
Iron Shovel: 15 → 40
Stone Axe: 30 → 60
Stone Dagger: 30 → 60
Wooden Spear: 15 → 30
Simple Lighter: 5 → 20
Flashlight: 10 → 50
Hammer: 10 → 40
[*]Jumping into the water now works correctly and no longer deals fall damage
[/list]

notes.title: Explore SAEs new Website: Your Portal to Thrilling Tropical Survival!
notes.content:
[h1]Our new Website[/h1]

Exciting news awaits! The [b]new official SAE website has officially launched[/b], marking the beginning of an exhilarating journey into the heart of tropical survival. Dive into our immersive online portal, meticulously crafted to be your ultimate companion in navigating the challenges of SAE.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/8e572650fef8256f80621f1fadf8706dc9147d75.jpg[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]

[b]Gain deep, regular insights into our development and make your ideas and wishes come true. Help us shape SAE for you![/b]

But our website is more than just a repository of information – it's [b]a vibrant community[/b] hub where adventurers like yourself can come together to share experiences, exchange ideas, and forge lasting connections. [b]Create your own profile[/b], interact with fellow explorers, and collaborate on exciting new ventures as we chart the uncharted territories of SAE together.

And let's not forget about our [b]online shop[/b], where you can gear up for your adventure with essential equipment and stylish merchandise. Admittedly, our online store is still pretty empty. But that will change soon!

[h2]🔗[url=https://www.sae-game.com/]www.sae-game.com[/url][/h2]

[h2]Help us develop SAE[/h2]

But perhaps the most exciting aspect of our website is the opportunity it presents for you to actively [b]shape the future and the release of SAE.[/b] Share your ideas, provide feedback, and contribute to the development process as we work tirelessly to make SAE an ultimate survival experience.

[b]Join us on this thrilling adventure and become part of the ever-growing SAE community.[/b] Visit our website today, and let's embark on this unforgettable journey together!

[b]Warm regards,
Your SAE Team[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743962/8b3b5ce3a667a510a4a5b959cbe885993371ab06.png[/img]
